headline: OIL COLLAPSE ON US-IRAN PAUSE: Brent -5.2% below $90 briefly; ES +1.0%, NQ +1.6% into FOMC/MSFT/META week
client_frame: Weekend pause on US-Iran strikes triggered classic risk-on unwind: oil -5%+, VIX -5%, futures +1%. Trump claimed 'deal complete' with Hormuz reopening; more measured US sources call it a diplomatic pause. Either way, this is the biggest single-session geopolitical de-risking since the June ceasefire. Watch: does the market sustain relief into FOMC Wed + $14T of mega-cap earnings (MSFT/META Wed AC, AAPL/AMZN Thu AC), or does Fed hawkish drift + capex fatigue reassert the three-legged risk stool.
